Name: CS_SSAO_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Screen-space ambient occlusion settings for each level of the SSAO option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: SSAO Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns SSAO on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Reprojection Mode
Fields.Description: Temporal reprojection of SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on. Retail: 1 up to Medium, 0 High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Bilateral Upscale Mode
Fields.Description: Bilateral upscale of SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on. Retail: 1 Off and Low, 0 Medium and High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Use Normals Mode
Fields.Description: Use of surface normals by SSAO: 0 follows the scene's setting, 1 forces it off, 2 forces it on. Retail: 1 up to Medium, 0 High, 2 Maximum.
